description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform upgrade procedures for different hardware boards. It includes functions for checking the image integrity and performing upgrade steps specific to certain device models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the bootloader has been replaced with U-Boot by verifying the string in the bootloader partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the hardware model identified by board_name.
